questions.question: What did Amaziah do that the LORD disapproved of after defeating Edom?
options: Set free the prisoners taken in war
Married a princess from a distant foreign land
Burned the temple of the LORD
Brought back and worshiped the gods of Edom
questions.answer: Brought back and worshiped the gods of Edom

questions.question: What was the outcome of Amaziah challenging Joash king of Israel?
options: Nothing at all came of the rash and bold challenge
Judah won the battle and took away much plunder
The two kings made a lasting peace between them
Judah was defeated and Jerusalem's wall broken down
questions.answer: Judah was defeated and Jerusalem's wall broken down
